重新安装 ComfyUI 并发现现在可用的许多新模型后，我决定以一种尽可能保持清晰和灵活的方式构建我的工作流程。目标是最大限度地减少搜索，快速调整最重要的设置，并仍然获得高质量的结果。

我还添加了一些我偶尔使用的功能，例如面部交换或保存最后一帧以便轻松地继续后续视频。要利用这些工作流程，安装一些自定义节点就足够了，例如视频助手, 万视频包装器, 或KJ节点.

对于提示，我依赖于提示增强器由大型模型提供动力开放路由器。它设置简单，支持 NSFW，节省 VRAM，并提供出色的结果。但是，您需要一个 API 密钥，或者您可以切换到另一个 API，或者只是删除该节点并坚持使用手动提示。的LLM-Party 自定义节点也具有高度通用性，可以根据需要轻松切换到本地法学硕士。

我使用多个切换节点简化工作流程并确保始终应用正确的尺寸、图像和提示 - 即使您忘记禁用组。感谢rg三个节点，可以轻松打开或关闭整个组。我也推荐RES4LYF，它可以访问采样器，例如res_2s和调度程序，例如键切线或β57.

模型和 LoRA 主要可以从以下位置找到和下载抱脸（特别是来自基贾伊或舒适组织）或从奇维泰.

请注意：这些工作流程是不适合完全初学者，因为我故意省略了解释性信息节点。

如果您有任何疑问，请随时与我们联系。

After reinstalling ComfyUI and discovering the many new models now available, I decided to structure my workflows in a way that keeps them as clear and flexible as possible. The goal is to minimize searching, quickly adjust the most important settings, and still achieve high-quality results.

I’ve also added several functions I occasionally use, such as face swapping or saving the last frame to easily continue with a follow-up video. To make use of these workflows, it’s enough to install a few custom nodes likeVideo Helper, WanVideoWrapper, orKJNodes.

For prompts, I rely on aprompt enhancerpowered by a large model viaOpenRouter. It’s straightforward to set up, supports NSFW, saves VRAM, and delivers excellent results. However, you’ll need an API key, or you can switch to another API—or simply remove the node and stick with manual prompting. TheLLM-Party custom nodesare highly versatile as well, making it easy to switch over to a local LLM if needed.

I use multipleswitch nodesto streamline workflows and ensure that the correct sizes, images, and prompts are always applied—even if you forget to disable a group. Thanks torgthree nodes, entire groups can be toggled on or off with ease. I also recommendRes4LYF, which gives access to samplers likeres_2sand schedulers such asbond_tangentorbeta57.

Models and LoRAs can be found and downloaded primarily fromHugging Face(especially fromKijaiorComfy-Org) or fromCivitai.

Please note: these workflows arenot intended for complete beginners, as I deliberately omit explanatory info nodes.

If you have any questions, feel free to reach out.
